name: BMS Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，BMS Holdings Berhad 拟以现金 RM23,800,000 收购位于 Selangor 的一处车间及办公室物业，以扩大运营设施；但该收购于2026年10月22日因双方未能就买卖协议条款达成最终一致而终止，定金已退还。公司未公告其他业务板块的扩张、缩减或退出事项。
overview_en: In 2026, BMS Holdings Berhad proposed to acquire a workshop and office property in Selangor for a cash consideration of RM23,800,000 to expand its operational facilities; however, the proposed acquisition was terminated on 22 October 2026 as the parties were unable to reach a final agreement on the terms of the SPA, and the earnest deposit was refunded. No other expansion, reduction, or exit of business segments was announced by the Company.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司拟收购车间及办公室物业以扩大运营设施，但该收购已终止。
segments.note_en: The Company proposed to acquire a workshop and office property to expand its operational facilities, but the acquisition was terminated.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Jubin BMS (1990) 与 Chyen Huat Hardware Sdn. Bhd. 于2026年10月22日双方同意终止上述拟议收购，因未能就买卖协议条款达成最终一致，定金已退还。
actions.text_en: Jubin BMS (1990) and Chyen Huat Hardware Sdn. Bhd. mutually agreed to terminate the proposed acquisition on 22 October 2026 as the parties were unable to reach a final agreement on the terms of the SPA, and the earnest deposit was refunded.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Jubin BMS (1990) Sdn. Bhd. 于2026年8月6日向 Chyen Huat Hardware Sdn. Bhd. 发出收购要约，拟以现金 RM23,800,000 收购位于 Selangor 的 Hulu Langat 一块约4,555平方米永久地契土地上的车间及办公室。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Jubin BMS (1990) Sdn. Bhd. issued a letter of offer on 6 August 2026 to Chyen Huat Hardware Sdn. Bhd.
